name: What is WoW: Forever?
summary: A reboot of vanilla World of Warcraft with modern graphics, quality-of-life changes and new systems. The level cap is 60 and stays there for good: no expansions are planned.
steps: New playable race: the Skyborne
Reworked specialisations: three per class across nine classes
New zones: Zephras Isle, the Riverglades, Shen'dralas and Mount Hyjal
Nine new dungeons alongside the Classic ones
New raids: Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit, plus Onyxia's Lair
New battleground: Darkspear Islands
New factions: Azeroth Commerce Authority and Durotar Supply and Logistics (Merchant's Favor)
Black Market NPCs selling certain materials at fixed prices
The Legacy system: account-wide talent trees and rewards
Camping: campfires with buff and crafting objects
Modern Collections and transmog
Updated graphics and weather, a Cooldown Manager and gamepad support

name: Character names: rules
summary: Every character needs a first and last name, and the pair must be unique across all rulesets in your region. Names are 2-12 characters with no spaces, numbers, symbols or punctuation.
steps: First and last name both required; the combination must be unique in your region
2-12 characters each; accented letters like ñ or ö are fine
No spaces, hyphens, numbers, symbols or apostrophes
No letter more than twice in a row; standard capitalisation
No slurs, obscenities, real politicians, Blizzard staff impersonation or major lore names (Thrall, Arthas, Sylvanas...)
Names can still be flagged later and force a rename
Roleplay realms: medieval/fantasy only, no famous references, one word
Pack owners could reserve up to 3 names before launch

name: Playing with a controller
summary: Forever supports gamepads for nearly everything, though a few menus still need a mouse. Turn on the Gamepad UI, then tune targeting and hotbars.
steps: Options → System → Gamepad (Alpha): tick Enable Gamepad UI (also under Gameplay in-game)
Turn on Show Input Legend
Lower back-pedal and run thresholds to about 0.3 for steadier running
Enable Show Input Prompts under Action Bars
Hold RB to target enemies or LB for friends, aim with the right stick
LB + RB + D-pad left/right switches action bar pages; hold LT/RT for other hotbar sets
Bind spells: Menu → Spellbook, highlight, press X, then the button; items: hover in bags, press Y, Bind
tips: Put frequent abilities on face buttons
Keep a separate page for buffs, food and utility
Leave Frame Focus Style on Gold

name: Blessing of Zephras (fast travel on Zephras Isle)
summary: Small tornadoes around Zephras Isle give the Blessing of the Zephras: +40% run speed for 5 minutes.
steps: Walk into a small tornado for the buff
Tornadoes don't always appear, even at their usual spots
It lasts 5 minutes and stays on in combat when you're hit
Any hostile action you take (attacks, spells, crowd control) ends it
tips: Plan routes between distant quests around the 5-minute buff
